newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison shares off low on warrant talk.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison shares off low on warrant talk.

text.p: Shares of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd edged up from lows in late trade on talks of a covered warrant issue on the stock, brokers said on Tuesday.
"Speculation that the warrant issuer might buy shares to cover the warrant aided buying," a local dealing manager said.

Hutchison shares rose HK$0.10 in late trade to HK$50 after touching an intraday low of HK$49.70. Volume was 3.59 million shares. Brokers said a total 60 million 10-for-one warrants, with a premium of 9.4 percent and gearing of 5.2 times, were expected to be issued.
